purpose: Freeze and authenticate the current upstream Fairy-Stockfish source strictly as the owner-required local baseline comparator, never as Crazyhouse-Stockfish source ancestry.

discovery_execution.clone: remote clone without checkout followed by detached exact checkout

required_observations: detached HEAD equals the frozen remote commit and the checkout is clean
all tracked files match their Git blob IDs
commit, tree, parents, authored and committed timestamps are recorded
license files and exact identities are recorded
build documentation and available architecture targets are inventoried without building
Crazyhouse variant option, evaluator option, network loader and network-format implementation paths are inventoried
the source's advertised default network names and embedded-network behavior are recorded without inferring compatibility from the .nnue extension
any submodules or generated dependencies are declared
namespace, source and process closure are hash-pinned
stopping_rule: This lease ends after source authentication and inventory. Any remote identity drift, checkout dirtiness, blob mismatch, missing or ambiguous license, submodule ambiguity or accidental build/engine execution rejects discovery and blocks comparator build preregistration.
